nodes.npc: Welcome to the team! I'm Jordan, your team lead. Why don't you tell us a bit about yourself?
nodes.npcZh: 歡迎加入！我是你的組長 Jordan。要不要跟大家簡單介紹一下自己？

replies.en: Hi everyone, I'm Taylor. I'll be supporting the sales team, and I'm really looking forward to working with you all.
replies.zh: 大家好，我是 Taylor，會協助業務團隊，很期待和大家合作。
replies.note: 完整介紹姓名與職責，正式又友善。

replies.en: Thanks, Jordan. I'm Taylor, the new sales assistant. I'm excited to be here.
replies.zh: 謝謝 Jordan。我是 Taylor，新來的業務助理，很高興來到這裡。
replies.note: 先感謝主管再自我介紹，簡短有活力。

nodes.npc: Great to have you here. Would you like to start with a project overview or a quick office tour?
nodes.npcZh: 很高興你加入。你想先聽專案簡介，還是先快速參觀辦公室？

replies.en: The project overview would help me get up to speed.
replies.zh: 先聽專案簡介，能幫我更快進入狀況。

replies.en: A quick tour sounds great. I'd like to get my bearings first.
replies.zh: 先參觀好了，我想先熟悉環境。

nodes.npc: We're putting together a proposal for a new client. You'll be organizing their customer feedback.
nodes.npcZh: 我們正在準備新客戶的提案，你會負責整理他們的客戶回饋。

replies.en: That sounds like a great way to learn about our clients.
replies.zh: 聽起來是了解客戶的好方法。
replies.note: 從正面角度回應，表現學習意願。

replies.en: Got it. I'm happy to dive right in.
replies.zh: 了解，我很樂意馬上投入。
replies.note: dive right in 表示「馬上投入」，語氣積極。

nodes.npc: This is the shared workspace, and the meeting rooms are just down the hall. The printer's by the kitchen.
nodes.npcZh: 這裡是共用工作區，會議室在走廊另一頭，印表機在茶水間旁邊。

replies.en: Thanks for showing me around. Where should I sit?
replies.zh: 謝謝你帶我參觀。我應該坐哪裡？

nodes.npc: You'll be right next to Sam from marketing. They can help you with the shared drive.
nodes.npcZh: 你坐在行銷部 Sam 旁邊，共用雲端硬碟的問題可以問他們。

replies.zh: 好，我去跟他們打聲招呼。

nodes.npc: Our team meeting is at ten thirty in Meeting Room B. The calendar invite should already be in your inbox.
nodes.npcZh: 團隊會議十點半在 B 會議室，行事曆邀請應該已經在你的信箱了。

replies.en: I'll check my inbox. Is there anything I should prepare beforehand?
replies.zh: 我會查看信箱。會前有什麼需要準備的嗎？

replies.en: Got it. Would it be OK if I just listened in this first time?
replies.zh: 了解。第一次我可以先旁聽就好嗎？

nodes.npc: Just skim the project summary and jot down any questions. No one expects you to know everything on day one.
nodes.npcZh: 快速看一下專案摘要，把問題記下來就好。沒有人會期待你第一天就什麼都懂。

replies.en: Understood. I'll review the summary and bring my questions.
replies.zh: 了解，我會看過摘要並帶著問題去。
replies.note: Understood 簡潔表示「了解」，常用於回覆主管。

replies.en: Sounds good. I'll make sure to go through it before the meeting.
replies.zh: 好的，我會在開會前確實看過。
replies.note: make sure to 強調會確實做到，語氣更積極。

nodes.npc: Of course. Feel free to jump in anytime if you have a question, though.
nodes.npcZh: 當然可以。不過有問題的話隨時可以發言。

replies.en: Thanks, that takes the pressure off.

nodes.npc: Perfect. Let me know if you have any trouble accessing the shared folder.
nodes.npcZh: 很好。共用資料夾如果有存取問題，再跟我說。

replies.en: Will do. Thanks for helping me settle in.
replies.zh: 好的，謝謝你幫我適應新環境。
replies.note: Will do 是「會的」的口語回覆，簡短自然。

replies.en: I will. I really appreciate the warm welcome.
replies.zh: 我會的，真的很謝謝大家熱情歡迎。
replies.note: 表達對歡迎的感謝，語氣溫暖。
